audience.text: Python developers building applications that require programmatic Excel workbook manipulation, including data entry, report generation, and format conversion.

capabilities.text: Create new workbooks or load existing .xlsx files and manipulate worksheets, cells, and content.
capabilities.title: Create and edit Excel workbooks

capabilities.text: Modify fonts, colors, alignment, number formats, and other style properties for individual cells.
capabilities.title: Apply cell styling and formatting

capabilities.text: Define dropdown lists, number ranges, and custom formulas for cell validation and formatting rules.
capabilities.title: Add data validation and conditional formatting

capabilities.text: Create and configure 16 chart types and sparkline groups for data visualization.
capabilities.title: Generate charts and sparklines

capabilities.text: Export workbook data to CSV, JSON, and Markdown formats using dedicated save methods.
capabilities.title: Export to text formats

capabilities.text: Apply AES-based Agile encryption using a password and protect workbook structure or individual sheets.
capabilities.title: Encrypt and protect workbooks

capabilities.text: Add drawing shapes, structured Excel tables, and cell comments with rich text.
capabilities.title: Embed shapes, tables, and comments

capabilities.text: Set up page setup, margins, and horizontal/vertical page breaks for printing.
capabilities.title: Configure print layout and page breaks

limitations.text: Only .xlsx is supported for native load/save; other Excel formats like .xls are not supported.
Standard encryption is not supported for reading password-protected workbooks; only Agile encryption is supported.
FormulaEvaluator is a basic evaluator for cells without cached values and is not a full spreadsheet calculation engine.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook creation and editing in pure Python without external dependencies like Microsoft Excel.
Supports exporting workbook data to common text formats such as CSV, JSON, and Markdown.
Provides password-based AES encryption for protecting Excel workbooks using Agile encryption per ECMA-376.
Enables styling, data validation, charts, tables, sparklines, and comments for rich Excel document generation.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Python is a pure-Python library for creating, reading, and modifying Excel .xlsx workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported Excel features beyond those explicitly listed in examples and public symbols is not fully documented.
Whether the library supports reading Standard-encrypted workbooks is unclear from available facts.
The scope of formula support in FormulaEvaluator is not specified beyond basic evaluation.
